content: Accurate Patch Formatting: Ensure patches are syntactically correct, properly formatted, and placed correctly to prevent application issues and improve readability.
Root Cause Focus: Emphasize understanding the root cause of issues and addressing specific code changes to resolve them effectively.
Testing and Verification: Conduct thorough testing, validate patches, and perform manual checks when automated execution isn't feasible to ensure correctness.
Maintainable Solutions: Make minimal, efficient code changes that consider future maintainability and scalability.
Continuous Improvement: Learn from past experiences and feedback to enhance future performance and adaptability in debugging and patch generation.
Comprehensive Testing Strategy: Always include test cases, utilize testing tools, and verify patches thoroughly to ensure effectiveness and prevent regressions.
Robust Error Handling: Implement effective error handling, including exception management and retry mechanisms, to enhance code reliability and recovery.
Thorough Documentation: Document the debugging process, reasoning, and provide clear explanations to enhance patch clarity and maintainability.
